items.name: Veilstone Pendant
items.unidentifiedDescription: A smooth gray pebble on a leather cord.
items.aiSummary: Shows the dead as pale figures to its wearer, and whispers the names of the drowned.

items.name: Ferryman's Compass
items.unidentifiedDescription: A cracked brass disc with a thin needle under dull glass.
items.aiSummary: Its needle never points north. It points to the nearest grave.

items.name: Ring of Hollow Hunger
items.unidentifiedDescription: A plain ring of tarnished metal.
items.aiSummary: A cursed ring that drains the wearer's warmth and strength a little each hour.

items.name: Drowned Crown
items.unidentifiedDescription: A thin circlet, rusted green at the edges.
items.aiSummary: The crown of a drowned king. It calls the dead to whoever wears it.

items.name: Tideglass Phial
items.unidentifiedDescription: A small glass vial, stoppered with wax, that holds a drop of cloudy water.
items.aiSummary: Holds a drop of the river's memory. Whoever drinks it sees visions of past drownings.

cases.action: I check my pockets before the crossing.
I turn the disc over in my fingers and study it.
I rub the ring on my finger and wait by the ferry post.
I hold up the vial and ask Odette: what is this?
